name: JD Vance
office: Vice President of the United States
stance: Opposes safety-first AI regulation and treats frontier labs' requests for regulation as possible regulatory capture.

statements.text: The AI future is not going to be won by hand-wringing about safety. It will be won by building

Personally, I feel a little bit weird about the fact that you have so many frontier AI tech companies kind of coming to the government and begging the government to regulate them. It feels a little bit to me like a bit of a Trojan horse.
